newsitem.title: NORWAY: Exxon fixes Jahre Viking at WS46 - Oslo Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Exxon fixes Jahre Viking at WS46 - Oslo Bourse.

text.p: Exxon Corp has fixed Mercur Tanker's Jahre Viking at a rate of WS46 for loading crude in Ras Tanura/Juaymah and unloading in the U.S. Gulf, the Oslo Bourse said on Tuesday.

"Jahre Viking is fixed for Exxon at full load, circa 550,000 mt," it said. "The intention is to load in Ras Tanura/Juaymah and unload in the U.S. Gulf. The rate is WS46 and loading days are November 11-December 3."

The brief statement said the fixing would mean an income of $27,300 a day over 98 days, excluding docking and extra costs for cleaning tanks. Including those extra items, income will be reduced to $18,500 days over 133 days.
